title: The Lonely Pig
text: Last Saturday, {{name}} went to Grandpa's farm. The sun was warm and bright. {{name}} ran to see the animals. A little pig sat alone by the gate. The pig looked very sad and quiet. 'Why are you sad?' {{name}} asked softly. The pig had no friends to play with. {{name}} wanted to help the little pig. Near the lake, a duck swam alone. By the grass, a hen looked for food. {{name}} had a good idea. 'Let us all play together!' {{name}} said. {{name}} took some bread and called the animals. The duck came first, then the hen. The little pig ran to them quickly. {{name}} threw bread on the soft grass. The pig and the duck ate side by side. The hen jumped and made a funny noise. Soon all the animals played in the sun. The little pig was not sad now. It ran and hopped around the farm. {{name}} laughed and clapped both hands. Grandpa came and saw the happy animals. 'You are a kind friend,' Grandpa said. {{name}} smiled at the little pig. Now the pig had three new friends.

summary: 主角去爷爷农场,发现一只孤单伤心的小猪,便用面包把鸭子和母鸡引来一起玩,帮小猪交到三个新朋友,小猪变得开心。
